items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing Scott Joplin's compositions (e.g., 'Ole Miss', 'Maple Leaf Rag') with other musicians, but never claims to have met, played with, or been influenced by Scott Joplin personally. Joplin is mentioned only as the composer of the repertoire.

ctx.x: But there's still, it's, uh, people like Dodds, and, uh, you know, Louis Armstrong, and so on, they, of course, they all went there, but...
Well, people engaged here more than us. People saw... stuff

I don't know anybody who would be the best friend, but you didn't get the opportunity to get off. That's when you were. Did you hear Johnny Dawes when you were married? I was Johnny Dawes. I was Johnny, I was Jimmy Newman, Charlie McQuirties, and he was one of the best. I was the man George Backing, he was one of the best. I was his brother. He was a kid, he was a kid.
